name: giovi365
intro: Fixed income and real estate research: rate forecasting, macro sensitivity, and the honest diagnostics that say how far to trust each model.

projects.title: US Treasury Yield Curve Forecaster
projects.description: An interactive 24-month forecast of the 3-month, 2-year and 10-year Treasury yields. Move macro levers (UK, Japan and German yields, US unemployment, FX, credit spreads, VIX) and watch the curve, the term spreads and the implied recession probability respond.
points: Ensemble of VARX, XGBoost and Diebold-Li, weighted by walk-forward backtest error
GARCH uncertainty bands and an Estrella-Mishkin recession probit (out-of-sample AUC 0.83)
Every model is scored against a random walk, with economic sign checks on each lever

projects.title: Real Estate Rate-Sensitivity Map
projects.description: An interactive map of how interest rates and macro factors flow through European rate-sensitive real estate and infrastructure, from construction and financing to ownership and valuation.
points: Each link explains the mechanism, which direction it pushes, and how to measure it
Built on ECB policy, financing costs, construction inputs and energy-efficiency data
